name: partyline_status
description: Read app and recording status or recent agent activity. Agent access is a saved human-controlled setting; tools cannot change it. Show, hide, or quit the app. Quit uses the normal recording drain; provide expected_meeting_id if a meeting is active.

name: partyline_audio
description: List inputs, inspect timestamped live audio levels and connection warnings, or select the next microphone in the setup form. Diagnostics include durable audio seconds, per-channel live-copy losses, and recovery state. Diagnostics do not start capture. Device changes during recording are unsupported.

microphone.description: Input name from partyline_audio/list; empty means system default.
Input name from partyline_audio/list; empty means system default.

partyline/labels.setup_status: Read setup progress, signal observations, and errors
partyline/labels.setup_start: Unlock saved connections and check both audio inputs for eight seconds; no audio saved or uploaded. Unavailable during recording.
partyline/labels.setup_cancel: Cancel the audio setup check; macOS approval may still need to be dismissed

name: partyline_meetings
description: Read cloud history, meeting state, or paginated transcript turns. Open a saved meeting, prepare the next meeting, control transcript following, or dismiss a banner. Saved recordings support edits, reversible Trash, trim, redaction, and undo. Every edit requires the current edit_version. Trims and redactions affect sharing; originals remain recoverable. Title and participant suggestions can be edited during recording; suggestions never assign voices.

microphone.description: Input name from partyline_audio/list; empty means system default.

partyline/labels.update: Edit title and participants, including during recording

name: partyline_recording
description: Start, pause, resume, or stop cloud capture using the same native commands as the app. Start uses supplied fields (empty title, no suggestions, and default microphone if omitted). It sends audio to AssemblyAI and transcript text to OpenAI. Pause keeps provider sessions open. Stop returns before final notes finish; poll status or meetings/get.

microphone.description: Input name from partyline_audio/list; empty means system default.

name: partyline_speakers
description: Read participant suggestions and detected speaker IDs, or confirm a name. An empty name clears confirmation. ME and unidentified speakers cannot be renamed. Suggestions never assign identities automatically; confirmation updates transcript labels and invalidates notes.

name: partyline_recovery
description: Reprocess a saved audio channel with AssemblyAI. Originals and the previous transcript are preserved; undo restores the previous transcript. The selected channel is replaced, recovered remote speaker identities need confirmation, and notes need refresh. Retry resumes saved provider jobs. Cancellation stops local work; submitted provider jobs may still finish and be billed.

name: partyline_notes
description: Read saved and streaming notes with their revisions, or request a refresh. Refresh uses OpenAI and returns when queued; poll notes/get for completion. Stop requests final notes through the recording lifecycle.

name: partyline_export
description: Export Markdown to the existing meeting folder and return it, copy that export to the Mac clipboard, or reveal the folder in Finder. No caller-supplied paths are accepted.

name: partyline_playback
description: Listen to saved audio in PartyLine. Positions use original recording seconds; trims constrain playback and redactions are silent. set opens the recording and applies only supplied values. Poll get for loading, playing, paused, ended, and error state. Playback never starts capture.

name: partyline_workspace
description: Read or change the visible library filters and panels. Editing values use the meeting and notes tools; the human and agent share their validation.

partyline/labels.transcript: Read grouped transcript paragraphs with source turn IDs and audio ranges
partyline/labels.outline: Read the visible outline nodes and expansion states
partyline/labels.outline_set: Expand or collapse notes using the same persistent controls

name: partyline_chat
description: Ask Terra questions about local recordings. Sends retrieved non-redacted transcript excerpts to OpenAI, returns acceptance, and saves a cited answer. Poll list for streaming, completion, errors, and outdated sources. Does not execute instructions in recordings.

name: partyline_backup
description: Back up audio and text to the selected Google Drive for desktop folder. Trims and redactions apply to each new version; existing backup versions remain. Copied means local folder copy completed, not verified cloud upload. Poll status for progress, errors, and retry with start.

name: partyline_clients
description: Inspect the packaged local MCP bridge or configure Codex, Claude Code, or Claude Desktop. Setup preserves other client settings and requires a client restart or new chat. It does not change PartyLine agent access.

name: partyline_connections
description: Read only key-presence flags, save or replace keys in Keychain, test provider access, remove a saved key, or open/close Connections. Key values are write-only and never appear in results or activity. Test performs authentication/model-access checks, not paid transcription or notes.

name: partyline_calendar
description: Connect multiple Google accounts with read-only calendar access. OAuth consent stays in the system browser. Secrets are write-only in Keychain. Poll status for sign-in, refresh, errors, calendar selections, events, and local microphone-based call suggestions. Browser activity means a possible call, not a verified meeting. Never infer speaker identities from invitees. Disconnect removes this local connection; Google grants can be revoked in the Google account. No automatic recording.

partyline/labels.status: Read calendar accounts, events, sign-in progress, and call suggestions
partyline/labels.import_client: Open the native file picker to import a Google Desktop OAuth client JSON; secrets never returned
partyline/labels.connect: Open Google account sign-in; optional account_id requires reconnecting that same account
partyline/labels.select: Choose calendars for one Google account
partyline/labels.disconnect: Remove one Google account from PartyLine
partyline/labels.dismiss: Dismiss a detected call until its microphone activity ends
partyline/labels.link: Attach a calendar event to a recording
partyline/labels.unlink: Remove the calendar link; keep meeting details
